newsitem.title: CHINA: China '97 edible oil imports seen under 2.0 mln T.
newsitem.headline: China '97 edible oil imports seen under 2.0 mln T.

text.p: China is expected to import no more than 2.0 million tonnes of edible oils in 1997, the Grains and Oils Market News said in an edition seen in Beijing on Friday.
China imported 2.64 million tonnes of edible vegetable oils, including palmoil, in 1996, down 25.3 percent from the previous year, customs figures show.
Imports of edible oils, including palmoil, reached 790,000 tonnes in the first four months of this year, down 19.1 percent year-on-year, the figures show.
China's output of rapeseed is expected to fall in 1997 because of a decline in planting area, the newsletter said.
China produced 9.1 million tonnes of rapeseed in 1996, down 6.0 percent from the previous year.
Domestic prices of edible oil are likely to increase in the rest of the year because of falling supply, the newsletter said, but gave no further details.
